Variadic va_arg gate: 4× mini_sprintf calls, 9× va_arg(unsigned int/int); formats '123+456', '-7/3', 'beef cafe', '999 -1 abcd'; folds output chars; bit-exact host==target (shared vaprintf.h)

Barnes-Hut quadtree N-body gate: 8 particles, 6 steps; recursive bh_insert/bh_force walk pooled-node tree via runtime child[] indices (pointer-chasing) + gravity kernel __mulsi3(5)/__divsi3(4); rep/sep=160, bh_force self-recursion; bit-exact host==target (shared bhut.h)

Perlin gradient-noise gate: Fisher-Yates permutation + inline Hermite fade 6t^5-15t^4+10t^3 (Q0.8, __mulsi3-heavy) + 4-way gradient dot + lerp; bit-exact host==target (shared perlin.h)

barycentric edge-function raster gate: 3 int32 cross-product edge fns (__mulsi3) + per-pixel barycentric divide (__divsi3); trips the a16/xy16 -verify rc-undef XFAIL (code bit-exact correct); host==target (shared gouraud.h)
Floyd-Steinberg signed error-diffusion gate: two-row error buffer, residual split (e*k)>>4 arithmetic shift, quantiser 3 compares + 4-level LUT, no division; bit-exact host==target (shared dither.h)

marching-squares gate: 4-bit corner-sign case -> 16-entry MS_SEG edge LUT + edge-crossing interpolation divide (__divsi3); trips the a16/xy16 -verify rc-undef XFAIL (code correct); host==target (shared msquares.h)
multi-dimensional array indexing gate: true uint8 grid[6][6][6] accessed grid[z][y][x] (compiler emits z*36+y*6+x), Moore-26 3-D life CA; bit-exact host==target (shared grid3d.h)
setjmp/longjmp non-local return on the 65816 native 16-bit stack (regression guard for the 6502-only common setjmp.S; #35)

#123 VBlank Interrupt Tally arithmetic gate (ORACLE form, no interrupts): 240 fenced ticks of xorshift16 + 16-bit multiply-add + 16x16->32 __mulsi3 accumulate, folded 4 rotations/tick; the interrupt-CC half is asserted separately by dev/nmitally.sh

#116 setjmp/longjmp multi-frame unwind gate (Round 6 Cluster G flagship): 8-queens with one setjmp choice point per recursion level; every dead end longjmps straight to the deepest still-viable ancestor, discarding a VARYING number of jsr frames in one jump (page-1 S reconstruct x soft-SP x __rc18..__rc31 CSR restore); folds 8 solution grids, visit/backtrack counters, summed unwind depth and the event trace (shared backtrack.h)

#117 setjmp/longjmp callee-saved-restore gate (Round 6 Cluster G): 14 coefficient bytes — the exact width of jmp_buf csrs[14] (__rc18..__rc31) — held in locals across a setjmp while a noinline worker occupies and rewrites every callee-saved slot, then longjmps past the epilogue that would restore them; an off-by-one in the restore offsets corrupts exactly one coefficient. Folds the post-longjmp vector of 6 passes plus the harmonograph curve (__mulsi3 32-bit chain) each one renders (shared csrjmp.h)

#118 setjmp/longjmp RE-ENTRY gate (Round 6 Cluster G): ONE setjmp site re-armed and re-entered 24 times, each attempt jumping back from a different call depth over a different soft-stack high-water mark (noinline recursive rj_work with six 16-bit locals live across the recursive call). Folds the whole retry-outcome sequence — per attempt the fault code, the deepest frame reached and the work result — plus the total call count. The slice that found the +mos-xy16 A16-clobber miscompile fixed 2026-09-15 (docs/investigations/2026-09-15-xy16-spill-reload-clobbers-store-value.md); shared retryjmp.h

#142 >128-successor jump-table gate (Round 8 Cluster A): ISA-256, a bytecode machine whose 256-way opcode dispatch is double legalizeBrJt's `Table.MBBs.size() <= 128` limit, so the `JMP (abs,X)` arm is structurally unreachable and the SPLIT low/high byte-table + G_BRINDIRECT arm (with its own MO_HI_JT relocation) must fire — the arm all five jump tables in demos #1-#141 avoid. Folds the register file, accumulator, all 256 bytes of VM memory, the plotted phase-portrait trace and the 256-bit opcode-coverage bitmap (shared jt256.h)

#143 G_DYN_STACKALLOC gate (Round 8 Cluster A): an RLE scanline decoder whose per-row scratch array is a VLA sized by the run count read out of the compressed stream and declared in the loop body, so the soft SP is adjusted and restored once per row with a different delta. Zero demos #1-#141 form G_DYN_STACKALLOC — #68 polyfill's VLA const-folds to a fixed alloca, covering only G_STACKSAVE/RESTORE. Folds the decoded image, every row's run count and the prefix sums computed THROUGH the dynamic array (shared vlastack.h)

#144 G_USUBO/G_SSUBO gate (Round 8 Cluster A): a reservoir cascade whose every transfer is a checked subtract via __builtin_sub_overflow at uint16 (borrow out), int16 and int32 (signed, opposite-sign operands — the pairing an add can never overflow on), with a detected underflow rejecting the transfer. __builtin_sub_overflow appears ZERO times across demos #1-#141; only the add (#44) and mul (#76/#101) forms. Folds accept/reject counts, the event trace and the final level vectors (shared borrowov.h)

#145 >32-bit BY-VALUE ARGUMENT gate (Round 8 Cluster A): classifyArgumentType (clang Targets/MOS.cpp:64) sends any aggregate over 32 bits indirect with ByVal=false at :71, so the callee gets a pointer to caller-owned storage and by-value semantics rest on a call-site copy. A 144-bit BvMat and a 64-bit BvVert travel through six stages that each MUTATE their own parameter; the driver re-reads its original after every call. #91 matcascade covered only the RETURN half. Folds every stage output, every transformed vertex and every re-read (shared bigbyval.h)

#146 G_FPEXT S32->S64 / G_FPTRUNC S64->S32 gate (Round 8 Cluster B): the same chaotic map (r = 125/32, exact in binary32) iterated two ways over identical binary32 state — once wholly at float, once PROMOTED to double for the step and DEMOTED back each iteration — so the lanes differ only in where the rounding happens and the step at which they separate is the measured output. ZERO corpus slices across demos #1-#141 link __extendsfdf2 or __truncdfsf2; #57 mandel-double uses double throughout but only forms __floatunsidf. Correctly-rounded IEEE only (+ - * and the two conversions), no libm; folds the uint32 bit pattern of every state of both lanes plus each orbit's divergence step and disagreement count (shared dblbridge.h)

#147 bsearch callback-ABI gate (Round 8 Cluster B): a strictly increasing 64-key table probed with 48 fixed queries containing both hits and deliberate misses, where each call returns a void* INTO the array (or NULL) that the caller must difference back into an index — a wrong conversion yields a plausible in-range index, not a crash. bsearch is used ZERO times across demos #1-#141; qsort (15x) is the only comparator-callback libc linked, and its comparator drives a swap rather than an interval bisection. Folds the keys, queries, found indices and miss sentinels; the probe trace is deliberately NOT folded (bisection order is unspecified and host/target libcs differ) — dev/bsearchviz.sh compares its signature across the three target modes instead (shared bsearchviz.h)

#148 memcmp/strcmp/strncmp gate (Round 8 Cluster B): 24 fixed-width string lanes with deliberate shared prefixes and one byte-for-byte duplicate, merged under lexicographic order by strcmp, then every adjacent pair re-compared by a 3-byte-bounded strncmp and a full-width memcmp that runs past each terminator into deterministic filler — so all three functions produce all three signs and genuinely disagree. All three symbols are used ZERO times tree-wide across #1-#141. Folds the SIGN of every comparison normalised to -1/0/+1 (never the magnitude, which C leaves implementation-defined), each comparison's resolving byte position and the final ordering. Measured negative: MOS never inline-expands memcmp at any constant size (shared strcmprace.h)

#149 packed-record LAYOUT INVARIANT gate (Round 8 Cluster B): a packed binary telemetry stream with two record shapes of coprime odd sizes (7 and 10 bytes) selected by a tag byte, parsed through a computed record pointer so every wide member is read from an offset the compiler cannot fold to a known alignment. REFRAMED honestly — on MOS every scalar already has ABI alignment 1, so an unpacked struct has no padding to remove and __attribute__((packed)) is a LAYOUT NO-OP (Round 8's second negative result; measured sizeof 10/7 packed vs 12/12 on the host). What this guards is the padding-free-layout invariant itself, asserted by the header's _Static_assert block and pinned by zero demos across #1-#141, on which every binary-format parse built with this toolchain depends. Folds every parsed field, every record start offset and the per-shape counts (shared packrec.h)

#150 G_TRAP gate (Round 8 Cluster B): a dense (state, event) machine with 20 legal pairs enumerated as case labels and 4 impossible ones falling to default: __builtin_trap(), which MOSLegalizerInfo.cpp:448 .custom()/legalizeTrap lowers to an RTLIB::ABORT libcall (jsr abort). The generator consults a per-state legality mask so an impossible pair never occurs, but tg_step is noinline and parameterised so the compiler cannot prove the default dead. __builtin_trap / __builtin_unreachable are used ZERO times across #1-#141, and __builtin_unreachable alone emits nothing at all. HONEST FRAMING: a trap terminates, so it can never be taken in a gate run — this is a PRESENCE-AND-INERTNESS probe, weaker than #142-#145. Folds only the reachable state trace, per-state visit counts and per-pair transition counts (shared trapguard.h)

#151 NESTED soft-SP unwind gate (Round 8 Cluster C): two VLAs in nested block scopes with independent runtime lengths, both re-entered once per loop iteration so the outer G_STACKSAVE/G_STACKRESTORE bracket survives AS a bracket around the inner one — measured, the obvious shapes (function-scope VLA + inner block; explicit outer block entered once) collapse to a single bracket because the outer restore coincides with the function's return. The inner length is derived from the OUTER allocation's contents, and the outer array is re-read after every inner block closes plus once more per row, because an overshooting unwind corrupts the outer array silently: no crash, no verifier complaint, the inner result still right. #143 vlastack covers ONE bracket at ONE depth; this is the depth axis. Folds the per-row reduction, every outer re-read, every inner allocation length and the row checksums — never a pointer value (shared vlanest.h)

#152 JUMP-TABLE BOUNDARY gate (Round 8 Cluster C): three noinline dispatchers over the same sixteen handler families with 127, 128 and 129 distinct successors, so both arms of legalizeBrJt and the exact `Table.MBBs.size() <= 128` test (MOSLegalizerInfo.cpp:3334) are compiled side by side in one program. All three are fed the SAME opcode stream, restricted to 0..126 so every opcode is in range for all three, over three independent copies of the same VM state — a boundary off-by-one that mis-indexed either arm by one slot lands in a neighbouring handler and moves exactly one of the three. #142 jt256 sits at 256, deep past the boundary. MEASURED: the boundary is exact and inclusive at 128 (127/128 emit `jmp (.LJTI,x)`, 129 emits `ldy .LJTI,x` + `lda .LJTI+256,x` + `jmp (__rc)`), and the split arm's tables are emitted at a fixed 256-byte stride regardless of entry count. Folds all three final VM states, all three traces and a three-way agreement flag (shared jtedge.h)

#153 SPARSE-SWITCH COMPARE-TREE gate (Round 8 Cluster C): the third switch-lowering strategy. A switch whose case values are too sparse to tabulate never reaches legalizeBrJt at all — it is lowered to a binary-search compare tree, structurally distinct from both jump-table arms (#142 jt256, #152 jtedge) and never deliberately forced by any prior demo. Two noinline dispatchers carry the SAME sixteen handler bodies — one at dense indices 0..15 (jump table), one at sparse keys 0..55555 (compare tree) — and every logical operation runs through both over independent copies of the same VM state, so strategy 3 is differentially checked against strategy 1 inside one program. Both default arms are deliberately exercised. Folds both final VM states, both traces, the miss counts and an agreement flag (shared jtsparse.h)

#154 >32-bit BY-VALUE ABI BOUNDARY gate (Round 8 Cluster C): classifyArgumentType (clang Targets/MOS.cpp) sends an aggregate indirect with ByVal=false when getTypeSize(Ty) > 32 and direct otherwise, so a 4-byte record and a 5-byte record sit on opposite sides of a one-byte difference and are compiled adjacently here. Three shapes travel through stages that each MUTATE their own parameter, and the driver re-reads its own original after every call — the only way a missing call-site copy is observable, since it corrupts the CALLER silently and leaves the callee's result correct. #145 bigbyval is 144 bits, far past the threshold; #26 boids is 32 bits, at it, with no indirect sibling in the same ROM. MEASURED CORRECTION: getTypeSize is in BITS and a MOS record is always whole bytes, so there is no 33-bit size class — a record declaring 33 bits of bitfield is sizeof 5 (40 bits) and takes the indirect path. This demo also found an OPEN upstream regalloc defect (see docs/investigations/2026-09-16-mos-regalloc-out-of-registers-mixed-width-pointer-plus-call.md). Folds every stage output, every caller re-read and a violation counter that must be 0; sizeof is deliberately NOT folded (5/5 on MOS, 8/6 on the host) (shared byvaledge.h)

#155 OVERFLOW-BUILTIN MATRIX gate (Round 8 Cluster C): all three builtins at all three widths with both signednesses — {add, sub, mul} x {16, 32, 64} x {unsigned, signed} = 18 cells — in ONE noinline kernel, every operand from runtime state and every result live across the others, so G_UADDO/G_SADDO, G_USUBO/G_SSUBO and G_UMULO/G_SMULO are selected and register-allocated next to each other under real pressure. #44, #76, #101 and #144 each test one family, at one or two widths, in a loop of its own; none tests the interaction. MEASURED: a probe with one CONSTANT operand per builtin folded cells away outright and lost G_SSUBO entirely, so both operands are runtime and the gate asserts every one of the 18 cells fired BOTH outcomes. __builtin_*_overflow is fully defined (infinite precision then wrapped into the result type), so host and target agree bit-for-bit at every width. Folds each cell's accumulated result and its overflow/clean counts plus all six final lanes (shared ovmatrix.h)
